title: Born-Haber Cycle Energy Level Constructor
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an interactive Born-Haber Cycle energy level diagram constructor for the formation of NaCl from its elements. Load the 'Lantern.glb' model using GLTFLoader from a CDN (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/) and place it as a decorative 3D element (scaled to 0.3) in the top-right corner of the 3D scene, representing a 'furnace of formation'. The scene should combine a 3D visualization area with DOM-based controls.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use an OrthographicCamera looking at the XY plane (z=0). The camera should frame a region roughly from (-12,-10) to (12,12) in world units.
- Background color: #1a1a2e. Add subtle ambient light (0.6) and a directional light from (5,10,7).
- The Lantern.glb model should glow softly (add a PointLight at its position, color orange, intensity 0.5).

BORN-HABER CYCLE STEPS (7 energy levels):
Define these steps with their standard enthalpy values (kJ/mol) for NaCl:
1. 'Elements' (Na(s) + 1/2 Cl2(g)) — reference level, energy = 0
2. 'Sublimation' (Na(g) + 1/2 Cl2(g)) — ΔH_sub = +107
3. 'Dissociation' (Na(g) + Cl(g)) — ΔH_diss = +122 (cumulative = +229)
4. 'Ionization' (Na+(g) + Cl(g)) — ΔH_ion = +496 (cumulative = +725)
5. 'Electron Affinity' (Na+(g) + Cl-(g)) — ΔH_ea = -349 (cumulative = +376)
6. 'Lattice Energy' (NaCl(s)) — ΔH_lattice = -787 (cumulative = -411)
7. 'Formation' (NaCl(s) verification) — ΔH_f = -411 (should match step 6 cumulative)

VISUALIZATION:
- Each energy level is a horizontal 3D bar (BoxGeometry, width=6, height=0.15, depth=0.3) positioned at a Y coordinate proportional to its cumulative energy. Map the energy range [-500, +800] to Y range [-8, +10].
- Bars are colored by type: endothermic steps = warm colors (orange/red gradient), exothermic = cool colors (blue/cyan gradient). The reference level is white.
- Vertical arrows (using CylinderGeometry or custom line geometry) connect consecutive levels, colored green for endothermic (up) and red for exothermic (down).
- Each bar has a 3D text label (use TextGeometry or sprite-based labels) showing the step name and cumulative energy value.
- Initially, only step 1 (Elements) is visible. Steps are added one at a time.

DOM UI (overlay):
- A panel on the left side with:
  - 'Add Next Step' button (id='btn-add-step') — adds the next energy level with animation
  - 'Remove Last Step' button (id='btn-remove-step') — removes the last added step (undo)
  - 'Reset All' button (id='btn-reset') — returns to only step 1
  - A dropdown (id='select-compound') with options: 'NaCl' (default), 'KCl', 'MgO'. Changing resets and loads different values.
    - KCl values: sub=89, diss=122, ion=419, ea=-349, lattice=-717, formation=-436
    - MgO values: sub=148, diss=249, ion=2188, ea=-141, lattice=-3850, formation=-601 (note: ion includes 1st+2nd ionization)
  - A span (id='total-energy-display') showing the current total cumulative energy of the last visible step.
  - A checkbox (id='chk-arrows') to toggle arrow visibility (default: checked/visible).
  - A span (id='step-counter') showing 'Step X/7'.
- A tooltip div (id='tooltip') that appears when hovering over a bar, showing detailed info.

KEYBOARD INTERACTIONS:
- Right Arrow or 'N' key: same as 'Add Next Step'
- Left Arrow or 'B' key: same as 'Remove Last Step'
- 'R' key: same as 'Reset All'
- '1'-'3' keys: select compound (1=NaCl, 2=KCl, 3=MgO)
- 'A' key: toggle arrow visibility

MOUSE INTERACTIONS:
- Clicking on a visible energy bar highlights it (emissive glow) and shows its details in the tooltip.
- The selected bar index is tracked.

ANIMATION:
- When a new step is added, the bar should animate from Y=previous_level to its target Y over 500ms (ease-out).
- The connecting arrow should grow simultaneously.
- The Lantern model should rotate slowly (0.005 rad/frame around Y axis).

STATE MANAGEMENT — expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- visibleSteps: number (1-7, how many steps currently shown)
- currentCompound: string ('NaCl', 'KCl', or 'MgO')
- cumulativeEnergies: array of cumulative energy values for all 7 steps of current compound
- lastVisibleEnergy: number (cumulative energy of the last visible step)
- selectedBarIndex: number (-1 if none selected, 0-6 otherwise)
- arrowsVisible: boolean
- lanternLoaded: boolean (true once Lantern.glb is loaded)
- lanternRotationY: number (current Y rotation of lantern in radians)
- barPositions: array of {x, y, z} for each visible bar's world position
- animating: boolean (true during bar add/remove animation)
- totalStepsAvailable: 7
- hessLawValid: boolean (true if the sum of individual ΔH values equals ΔH_formation — Hess's Law check)
- energyConserved: boolean (true if lastVisibleEnergy equals sum of all individual steps up to visibleSteps)
- undoCount: number (how many times remove/undo has been called)
- stepHistory: array of step indices that have been added (for undo tracking)
physics_constraints: Hess's Law must hold: the sum of all individual enthalpy changes must equal the overall enthalpy of formation. Energy conservation must be maintained at every step — cumulative energy at step N must exactly equal the sum of individual ΔH values from step 1 to N. Bar Y positions must be proportional to cumulative energy with no NaN or Infinity values. The cycle must close: the formation enthalpy computed from the cycle must match the direct formation enthalpy within ±1 kJ/mol tolerance.
